sentences.cn_text: 在世界各地，律师比其他任何职业的从业者都更容易招致敌意——新闻业或许是唯一的例外。
sentences.en_text: All around the world, lawyers generate more hostility than the members of any other profession — with the possible exception of journalism.

sentences.cn_text: 但几乎没有哪个地方的客户比美国的客户更有理由抱怨。
sentences.en_text: But there are few places where clients have more grounds for complaint than America.

sentences.cn_text: 在经济危机前的十年里，美国用于法律服务的支出增速是通货膨胀率的两倍。
sentences.en_text: During the decade before the economic crisis, spending on legal services in America grew twice as fast as inflation.

sentences.cn_text: 顶尖律师赚得盆满钵满，吸引越来越多的学生涌入法学院。
sentences.en_text: The best lawyers made skyscrapers-full of money, tempting ever more students to pile into law schools.

sentences.cn_text: 但大多数法学院毕业生从未能进入大律所工作。
sentences.en_text: But most law graduates never get a big-firm job.

sentences.cn_text: 他们中的许多人反而成了那种提起无理诉讼的麻烦制造者，使侵权制度成为代价高昂的噩梦。
sentences.en_text: Many of them instead become the kind of nuisance-lawsuit filer that makes the tort system a costly nightmare.

sentences.cn_text: 造成这种情况的原因有很多。
sentences.en_text: There are many reasons for this.

sentences.cn_text: 原因之一是法律教育的成本过高。
sentences.en_text: One is the excessive costs of a legal education.

sentences.cn_text: 在美国大多数州，成为律师只有一条路径：先获得某个非相关专业为期四年的本科学位，再在美国律师协会认证的200所法学院之一取得为期三年的法律学位，然后进行费用高昂的律师资格考试备考。
sentences.en_text: There is just one path for a lawyer in most American states: a four-year undergraduate degree in some unrelated subject, then a three-year law degree at one of 200 law schools authorized by the American Bar Association and an expensive preparation for the bar exam.

sentences.cn_text: 这使得如今的普通法学院毕业生在本科债务之外还背负着10万美元的债务。
sentences.en_text: This leaves today’s average law-school graduate with $100,000 of debt on top of undergraduate debts.

sentences.cn_text: 法学院债务意味着他们必须拼命工作。
sentences.en_text: Lawschool debt means that they have to work fearsomely hard.

sentences.cn_text: 改革这一体系既有利于律师，也有利于他们的客户。
sentences.en_text: Reforming the system would help both lawyers and their customers.

sentences.cn_text: 合理的改革思路早已存在，但管理该行业的州级机构过于保守，未能将其付诸实施。
sentences.en_text: Sensible ideas have been around for a long time, but the state-level bodies that govern the profession have been too conservative to implement them.

sentences.cn_text: 其中一个思路是允许人们在本科阶段学习法律。
sentences.en_text: One idea is to allow people to study law as an undergraduate degree.

sentences.cn_text: 另一个思路是允许学生在法学院学习两年后就参加律师资格考试。
sentences.en_text: Another is to let students sit for the bar after only two years of law school.

sentences.cn_text: 如果律师资格考试确实是对准律师足够严格的测试，那么应该允许能够提前参加考试的人这样做。
sentences.en_text: If the bar exam is truly a stern enough test for a would-be lawyer, those who can sit it earlier should be allowed to do so.

sentences.cn_text: 不需要额外培训的学生可以将债务负担减少三分之一。
sentences.en_text: Students who do not need the extra training could cut their debt mountain by a third.

sentences.cn_text: 成本居高不下的另一个原因是该行业限制性的行会式所有权结构。
sentences.en_text: The other reason why costs are so high is the restrictive guild-like ownership structure of the business.

sentences.cn_text: 除哥伦比亚特区外，非律师不得持有律师事务所的任何股份。
sentences.en_text: Except in the District of Columbia, non-lawyers may not own any share of a law firm.

sentences.cn_text: 这导致收费居高不下，创新步伐缓慢。
sentences.en_text: This keeps fees high and innovation slow.

sentences.cn_text: 法律界内部存在变革的压力，但监管机构中的变革反对者坚称，将外部人士排除在律师事务所之外，可以使律师免受赚钱压力的影响，从而更符合职业伦理地服务客户。
sentences.en_text: There is pressure for change from within the profession, but opponents of change among the regulators insist that keeping outsiders out of a law firm isolates lawyers from the pressure to make money rather than serve clients ethically.

sentences.cn_text: 事实上，允许非律师持有律师事务所股份将降低成本并改善客户服务，因为这会鼓励律师事务所使用技术并聘用专业管理人员，专注于提高事务所效率。
sentences.en_text: In fact, allowing non-lawyers to own shares in law firms would reduce costs and improve services to customers, by encouraging law firms to use technology and to employ professional managers to focus on improving firms’ efficiency.

sentences.cn_text: 毕竟，澳大利亚和英国等其他国家已经开始推动其法律行业自由化。
sentences.en_text: After all, other countries, such as Australia and Britain, have started liberalizing their legal professions.

sentences.cn_text: 美国也应效仿。
sentences.en_text: America should follow.

sentences.cn_text: 许多学生选择法律作为职业是由于____。
sentences.en_text: A lot of students take up law as their profession due to ____

sentences.cn_text: 客户需求不断增长
sentences.en_text: the growing demand from clients.

sentences.cn_text: 通货膨胀压力不断加大
sentences.en_text: the increasing pressure of inflation.

sentences.cn_text: 在大律所工作的前景
sentences.en_text: the prospect of working in big firms.

sentences.cn_text: 经济回报的吸引力
sentences.en_text: the attraction of financial rewards.

sentences.cn_text: 以下哪项增加了美国大多数州的法律教育成本？
sentences.en_text: Which of the following adds to the costs of legal education in most American states?

sentences.cn_text: 本科阶段更高的学费
sentences.en_text: Higher tuition fees for undergraduate studies.

sentences.cn_text: 律师协会的入学审批
sentences.en_text: Admissions approval from the bar association.

sentences.cn_text: 攻读另一专业的学士学位
sentences.en_text: Pursuing a bachelor’s degree in another major.

sentences.cn_text: 接受专业协会的培训
sentences.en_text: Receiving training by professional associations.

sentences.cn_text: 法律体系改革的障碍源于____。
sentences.en_text: Hindrance to the reform of the legal system originates from ____

sentences.cn_text: 律师和客户的强烈抵制
sentences.en_text: lawyers’ and clients’ strong resistance.

sentences.cn_text: 管理该行业的僵化机构
sentences.en_text: the rigid bodies governing the profession.

sentences.cn_text: 对准律师的严格考试
sentences.en_text: the stern exam for would-be lawyers.

sentences.cn_text: 非专业人士的尖锐批评
sentences.en_text: non-professionals’ sharp criticism.

sentences.cn_text: 行会式所有权结构被认为具有「限制性」，部分原因是它____。
sentences.en_text: The guild-like ownership structure is considered “restrictive” partly because it ____

sentences.cn_text: 禁止外部人士参与该行业
sentences.en_text: bans outsiders’ involvement in the profession.

sentences.cn_text: 阻止律师持有律师事务所股份
sentences.en_text: keeps lawyers from holding law-firm shares.

sentences.cn_text: 加剧了该行业的职业伦理问题
sentences.en_text: aggravates the ethical situation in the trade.

sentences.cn_text: 妨碍律师获得应得的利润
sentences.en_text: prevents lawyers from gaining due profits.

sentences.cn_text: 在本文中，作者主要讨论____。
sentences.en_text: In this text, the author mainly discusses ____

sentences.cn_text: 美国律师事务所存在缺陷的所有权结构及其成因
sentences.en_text: flawed ownership of America’s law firms and its causes.

sentences.cn_text: 促成美国成功律师的各种因素
sentences.en_text: the factors that help make a successful lawyer in America.

sentences.cn_text: 美国法律行业的一个问题及其解决方案
sentences.en_text: a problem in America’s legal profession and solutions to it.

sentences.cn_text: 本科教育在美国法律教育中的作用
sentences.en_text: the role of undergraduate studies in America’s legal education.
